prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE portrait scene for chapter 15. Image 1 shows this same place on an earlier visit (or its neighbouring coast). Preserve its architecture, palette, landmarks and spatial orientation while applying the scene below.
Earnest rustic hand-coloured woodcut on warm ochre paper: slate blue water, muted olive vegetation, clay red accents, warm black irregular cuts. Broad simpler lines, occasional knife slips, dry missed ink and imperfect colour registration. Beautiful old printed landscape, not cute, not a game illustration. Portrait 390:844 composition. No writing, borders, UI, loose inventory objects or people.
SCENE: Return to the SAME russet-grey quarry and timber shelter. Now a small clay kiln and brick forge have been built at upper left under shelter, with an anvil. No large finished heap of charcoal. Same broad pale working floor and right-edge space for iron quarry hotspot.
Generous natural play space: the middle 70% of the width from 38% to 90% of the image height is a continuous empty pale ochre clearing or worn floor, with faint sparse print grain only. Keep scenery in the top third and outer margins. No clutter, strong shadows or dense hatching through this open working space. Do not draw a rectangular blank panel.
Any river keeps flowing RIGHT to LEFT.
Reserve an open natural patch centered 78% from left and 64% from top for separate hotspot art of the exposed iron-bearing rock at the right edge of the quarry floor. Do not paint this hotspot object twice, and do not draw markers.
